trend: Late dinners and sleep: dinner-to-bed time and reflux (case-control study)
why: Indian office dinners often land at 10 PM. Uses the approved shape: a named study, one hard number, one honest caveat. No product.
text:
In a Japanese study, people who went to bed within 3 hours of dinner had about 7 times the odds of acid reflux of those who waited 4 hours or more.

It's self-reported and observational. Still, if dinner is at 10:30 and bed at 11, moving one of them is worth a try.
